seoDescription: Answers about choosing a machine, ordering and support.
title: Frequently asked questions
lead: Answers about choosing a machine, ordering and support. Can’t find what you need? Our team is happy to help.

buying.q1: Which flour mill is suitable for home use?
buying.a1: For household grinding, the 1 HP Standard Model (8–10 kg capacity) and the 1.5 HP Box Model (2 in 1) are compact stoneless mills designed for daily home use. Larger households that grind more often can consider the 2 HP models with a 10–12 kg capacity.
buying.q2: Can I see the Atta Chakki before I buy?
buying.a2: Yes. Book a free home demo and our team will visit your home, demonstrate the Atta Chakki and answer all your questions. You decide only after you are satisfied.
buying.q3: Which Atta Chakki is right for my family?
buying.a3: Tell us which grains you use and roughly how much flour your family needs. Our team will recommend the right model — book a free home demo, send an enquiry or message us on WhatsApp.

products.a1: The {store} 1.5 HP Atta Chakki is suitable for wheat, jowar, bajra and gram (besan), as well as turmeric, chilli and other dry spices. Its 7-sieve (7 chalni) set lets you choose how fine your flour is.
products.q2: How much electricity does the Atta Chakki use?
products.a2: The {store} 1.5 HP Atta Chakki runs on standard single-phase household electricity and uses approximately 1 unit of electricity for 10 kg of grinding, with a capacity of approximately 8–10 kg per hour.
products.q3: Is the Atta Chakki safe to use at home?
products.a3: The {store} 1.5 HP Atta Chakki has a child safety lock and an auto start system, and {store} mills feature overload protection and a 100% copper winding motor.

orders.q1: How do I place an order?
orders.a1: Add the machine you want to your cart and complete the secure online checkout — you can then follow the order status from your account. If a machine is out of stock, or you would like help choosing first, send an enquiry or request a quote and our team will get back to you.
orders.q2: What information is required to book a demo or get a quote?
orders.a2: Your name, phone number and area are enough to book a free home demo. For a quote, tell us the Atta Chakki model you are interested in and your delivery location.
orders.a3: Yes — shipping is free for orders within 200 km. Delivery options for your address are shown at checkout before you pay; for locations further away, please contact our team.

support.a1: Yes — {store} provides customer support and service, and our team can guide you on choosing the right model and motor for your requirement. Please contact us for support specific to your machine.
support.a2: Please contact our team for current availability and details.

more.title: Still Have Questions?
more.lead: Tell us what you grind and how much — our team will help you choose the right machine.
